column1: # Runtime and build dependencies: the single list read by install.sh (package
# names per distro) and `yozakura doctor` (checks). Tab-separated columns:
#   id      short name shown to the user
#   need    required (the shell does not start without it), standard
#           (installed by default; a feature degrades without it), build,
#           hyprland|niri|mango (required only for that compositor), or an
#   check   alternatives separated by "|": a command on PATH, an absolute
#           path glob, or font:<family substring>; "-" = package query only
#   arch    Arch packages (space-separated; aur:<name> from the AUR, "-" none)
#   fedora  Fedora packages (lionheartp/Hyprland COPR for the Hyprland stack)
# Rows without packages ("-") are built from this repository by the installer.
